ctx.add-comment.note: ledger ctx.add-comment: AddComment ctx row is ungated and openCommentDialog() opens #comment-dialog (editor.js:9894/4345)

ctx.spellcheck.note: ledger ctx.spellcheck (Review ribbon spellcheck / F7, not in ctx menu): F7 runs toggleSpellcheck(true) which flips #editor spellcheck to false so the WO engine owns the squiggles (editor.js:10973/11426); spellState.enabled defaults false

ctx.rotate-text-down.note: ledger ctx.rotate-text-down: TextDirRotateDown is a data-subitem child of the TextDirection parent; trigger opens the submenu, post clicks the child, applyTextDirection sets td writing-mode vertical-rl + wo-textdir-down (editor.js:10270/10331)

ctx.rotate-text-up.note: ledger ctx.rotate-text-up: TextDirRotateUp submenu child maps to applyTextDirection('rotate-up') = writing-mode sideways-lr on the block (td) under the selection (editor.js:10272/10331)

ctx.page-break-before.note: ledger ctx.page-break-before: ungated ctx row emits insertPageBreak which inserts <div class="page-break"> plus a trailing paragraph at the selection (editor.js:9948/1177)

ctx.keep-lines-together.note: ledger ctx.keep-lines-together: KeepLines ctx row emits toggleKeepLines which toggles the keep-lines class on the block(s) under the selection (editor.js:10151/1354)

ctx.horizontal.note: ledger ctx.horizontal KNOWN GAP: applyTextDirection('horizontal') reverts to the default state (removes writing-mode/data-textdir) — a no-op on default-state text; observing it needs a pre with a pre-rotated (vertical) fixture, which the pre vocabulary lacks (editor.js:10268/10327)

ctx.accept-change.note: ledger ctx.accept-change KNOWN GAP: the ctx item is ungated but trackedChangeAtSelection('accept') needs ins.track-insert/del.track-delete at the caret; without a track-changes fixture it only sets a status message (editor.js:10177/3038) — needs track-changes fixture pre

ctx.reject-change.note: ledger ctx.reject-change KNOWN GAP: same as accept — trackedChangeAtSelection('reject') needs a tracked-change fixture at the caret, else only a status message — needs track-changes fixture pre

ctx.follow-move.note: ledger ctx.follow-move KNOWN GAP: data-showif="trackchanges" keeps the ctx item hidden without a tracked-move fixture — needs track-changes fixture pre

ctx.ignore.note: ledger ctx.ignore KNOWN GAP: data-showif="misspelled" keeps the ctx item hidden without a misspelled-word fixture — needs misspelled-word fixture pre

ctx.ignore-all.note: ledger ctx.ignore-all KNOWN GAP: data-showif="misspelled" keeps the ctx item hidden without a misspelled-word fixture — needs misspelled-word fixture pre

ctx.add-to-dictionary.note: ledger ctx.add-to-dictionary KNOWN GAP: data-showif="misspelled" keeps the ctx item hidden without a misspelled-word fixture (handler unwraps the spell marker via spellAddToDictionaryAtSelection) — needs misspelled-word fixture pre

ctx.select-language.note: ledger ctx.select-language KNOWN GAP: data-showif="misspelled" keeps the ctx item hidden without a misspelled-word fixture; the handler only showPicker()s the #doc-lang select (no dialog) — needs misspelled-word fixture pre

ctx.update-1-style.note: ledger ctx.update-1-style KNOWN GAP: shares the FormattingAsStyle ctx row which only dispatches the wo:style-from-format CustomEvent — style update is owned by the host shell channel, no listener mutates the editor page DOM (editor.js:10163)

ctx.formatting-as-style.note: ledger ctx.formatting-as-style KNOWN GAP: FormattingAsStyle dispatches wo:style-from-format at window level; the style gallery/host shell owns the effect — no observable DOM mutation in the editor page (editor.js:10163)

$skipped.reason: ctx-menu Undo routes to editor history (emitCommand undo) — no observable DOM/state delta on a fresh page without prior history
ctx-menu Redo routes to editor history (emitCommand redo) — nothing to redo on a fresh page, no observable delta
clipboard operation not observable in-page (system clipboard, no DOM contract)
